verdict.rationale: Deepgram explicitly documents mid-conversation function calling where the model describes an action and the app executes it (deepgram-docs-2, deepgram-docs-20), and the API supports injecting agent messages mid-call (deepgram-docs-11) which could be used to fill dead air. However, there is no explicit documentation of automatic filler speech, latency-masking behavior, or best-practice guidance for avoiding awkward silence during function execution. Missing for 10: explicit filler/hold-message mechanism during function calls, documented latency benchmarks for function round-trips, and independent/hands-on evidence confirming no dead air occurs in practice.
